subject: Request: multi-year pricing exception & renewal protection for NexaHealth
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily@nexahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Smith <d.smith@nexahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Multi-year pricing request and renewal protection

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. After an internal review the Nexa procurement team asked me to follow up with a formal request for a 3-year committed pricing plan. Key asks from our side: 1) a price lock for the initial 3-year term (no increases above the agreed schedule), 2) an annual uplift cap of 5% (or CPI if lower) for years 2 and 3, and 3) a renewal protection clause to preserve preferential pricing on renewal if we meet commit thresholds.

We are prepared to commit to an annual spend of ~$1.2M ARR (platform + modest usage growth) if we can get a 20% discount off list for year 1, and the uplift cap noted above. Given our compliance needs (HIPAA-related), Nexa would also like a 99.95% uptime SLA and routine SOC 2 evidence in the contract.

Can you escalate this for pricing/leadership approval? Procurement would like a redline-ready contract by next week.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Head of Clinical Ops, NexaHealth
emily@nexahealth.com

Subject: Fwd: Multi-year pricing request and renewal protection

Team — forwarding Nexa's asks. Quick summary: 3-year commit (~$1.2M ARR), request 20% year-1 discount, 5% annual uplift cap, price lock for 3 years, renewal protection, SLA 99.95% + SOC2 evidence. Customer in regulated healthcare vertical; strategic account (pilot of clinical assistant).

Proposed internal position for deal desk escalation:
- Approve price lock for 3 years if customer commits to 3-year MRC and 12-months prepayment or automated invoicing cadence;
- Approve up to 10% off list year-1 as standard; anything >10% requires Sales Leader signoff;
- Uplift cap request: we can entertain a capped index (CPI) or fixed 6% max per year — needs Finance signoff;
- Renewal protection to be scoped: we can offer preferential renewal rates if usage growth >= X% and no major downgrades; legal to confirm language.

Asking for: 1) Marissa — sales leader signoff for >10% discount and renewal protection; 2) Markus — finance signoff on uplift cap at 5% vs 6% and acceptable margin; 3) Lauren — legal input on proposed renewal protection language and SOC2 commitments.

I'll attach the customer's intent doc to the HubSpot deal and draft an amendment.

Karthik
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 12:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Multi-year pricing request and renewal protection

Karthik — appreciate the summary. High level: I am sympathetic to supporting Nexa (healthcare pilot + reference potential). I will approve an exception to standard discounts, with conditions:

- Approve up to 18% off list in year 1 (exception to the 10% guardrail) provided we secure a 3-year minimum commitment and a 12-month payment term upfront or equivalent security.
- For uplift cap, we will accept a maximum of 7% per year (not to exceed CPI if CPI is higher) for years 2 and 3, but require that any third-party pass-through increases (cloud egress/network pass-throughs) are excluded from the cap — i.e., they can be passed-through separately.
- Renewal protection: we can include language that allows the customer to renew at the lesser of (a) the then-current contracted rate, or (b) a negotiated market-rate discount if they meet commit thresholds. This must be limited to one renewal term and contingent on no material breach. Legal to draft precise clause.

Attachments: I'm attaching the SOW and a 3-year pricing model that Karthik should use as the baseline for the amendment.

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

---
Attachments: Nexa_SOW_v3.pdf, Pricing_Model_3yr.xlsx
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Multi-year pricing request and renewal protection

Karthik / Marissa — ran the numbers with Finance. Context: target gross margin for this book is 60%+ post-discount; we need to ensure uplift caps don't erode margin if usage grows faster than expected. Recommendation and approval:

- Approve 18% year-1 discount (as Marissa proposed) — Finance signs off.
- Uplift cap: approve a firm cap of 6% per year for years 2 and 3 (this is the Finance-approved compromise between the customer's 5% ask and Marissa's 7% allowance).
- Require an addendum that explicitly excludes third-party pass-through costs and clarifies that any extraordinary cost increases (e.g., contractual pass-throughs from our infra partners) will be handled via separate change orders.

Final ask for Sales: confirm payment terms (we prefer 12 months prepay or automated annual invoicing) and have Legal issue the amendment with renewal protection language limited to one renewal as proposed. Once that's in place, Finance will sign SOW.

-Markus
VP Finance, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
From: Emily Park <emily@nexahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nexahealth.com>, Daniel Smith <d.smith@nexahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year pricing request and renewal protection

Karthik — this is great, thanks to you, Marissa and Markus for moving quickly. Nexa accepts the terms subject to Legal review: 18% off year 1, 6% uplift cap years 2–3, price lock for the 3-year term, renewal protection limited to one renewal term, and exclusion of third-party pass-throughs. Procurement prefers to prepay year 1 and then move to annual automated invoicing thereafter.

Please send the amendment and SOW for signatures. We'll route DocuSign on our side once we have the redline.

Best,
Emily
